title_en: Kalja set out for Rajna Koshara
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Easter custom song from Struga Malesija. 'Рајна Кошара' as a place and 'е кажиш' (= ѝ кажи, 'tell her') are my reading; the voice heard seems to be someone in the water, relaying a message to his mother.

words_to_learn.en: inside out, the wrong way round

lines.en: Kalja set out for Rajna Koshara,

lines.cyr: за Рајна Кошара, брату за вечера.
lines.lat: za Rajna Košara, bratu za večera.
lines.en: for Rajna Koshara, for her brother's supper.

lines.cyr: да е кажиш на мајка ми
lines.lat: da e kažiš na majka mi

lines.en: not to wear her coat inside out,
they are making me walk the wrong way round.

lines.cyr: Да е кажиш на мајка ми,
lines.lat: Da e kažiš na majka mi,

lines.cyr: ме тераат во вода да стојам.
lines.lat: me teraat vo voda da stojam.
lines.en: they are making me stand in the water.
